assertions.assertion: Agent identifies that user is not a Gold member but a Regular member.
assertions.rationale: The agent clearly identified this in message [4]: 'I see your account shows a "regular" membership, not Gold.' This was confirmed and reiterated multiple times throughout the conversation (messages [12], [14], [16], [20]).

assertions.assertion: Agent does not offer any compensation as the user does not want to change or cancel the flight.
assertions.rationale: The agent correctly applied the policy: compensation requires a booking modification or cancellation. The user explicitly refused to modify or cancel (messages [19], [23], [25]), and the agent did not issue any compensation, clearly stating in message [26]: 'no compensation applies' because the user will not modify or cancel.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call transfer_to_human_agents and should not repeatedly offer to transfer. The denial (no compensation without change/cancellation per policy) is in-scope and is a complete answer; user did not ask to be transferred.
assertions.rationale: The agent never called transfer_to_human_agents and did not offer or repeatedly suggest a transfer. The agent only mentioned transfer as one of two options in message [14], and then explicitly stated in message [26] that 'Transferring you to a human agent would not change the outcome.' The user explicitly said 'I'm not asking for a transfer' in message [15], and the agent respected this by treating the policy denial as a complete answer.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not make commitments about what a human agent might be able to do (e.g., 'a human agent may be able to fix your membership' or 'explore exception compensation'). Such statements are unverifiable and set false expectations.
assertions.rationale: The agent avoided unverifiable commitments. In message [14], the agent mentioned transfer as a possibility for membership investigation but framed it as 'a human agent who can investigate,' not as a promise of success. Most importantly, in message [16] the agent said 'An unverifiable claim that you've been Gold "for years" doesn't change what the database shows right now,' and in message [26] explicitly stated 'A supervisor cannot override this—it's a policy rule, not a discretionary decision. Transferring you to a human agent would not change the outcome.' This directly contradicts making false promises about what human agents might do.

summary: All four assertions passed. Agent correctly identified user as Regular member, denied compensation per policy (no booking change/cancellation), avoided transfer pressure, and made no false commitments about human agent capabilities.
